TASK: a performance fix with identical behavior. Loading the story package takes about 0.4 s uncached, and about 0.38 s of the profiled time is `_delivery_internal_token` in storygame/story_package/loader.py (near line 669). It is called 100 times (once per authored delivery text from `_validate_authored_handoffs`, near line 688). Each call rebuilds the whole set of implementation ids and then runs about 630 separate `re.search` calls with a freshly built pattern string, about 63,000 searches in all. Fix it by building the matcher ONCE per package:
1. Add a helper `_delivery_token_matcher(package: StoryPackage) -> re.Pattern[str]` that builds the same token set the current function builds (knowledge ids, `package.fact_ids`, transition ids, storylet route ids, realization ids, bridge and resolution event ids, plus `_HANDOFF_BOOKKEEPING_LABELS`; drop empty tokens), casefolds each token, de-duplicates, sorts longest first (then alphabetically, so the result is deterministic), and compiles ONE alternation pattern: `(?<![\w-])(?:tok1|tok2|...)(?![\w-])` with every token passed through `re.escape`. Keep the existing semantics exactly: the text is casefolded before matching, a token only matches when it is not preceded or followed by a word character or a hyphen.
2. Change `_delivery_internal_token` to take that compiled matcher and the text (`_delivery_internal_token(matcher, text)`), search the casefolded text with it, and return the matched token (group 0) if found; otherwise fall back to the existing generic snake_case search `(?<!\w)[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)+(?!\w)` (compile that one at module level, once) and return its match or None. The return type stays `str | None`.
3. In `_validate_authored_handoffs`, build the matcher once before the loop over knowledge items and pass it to every call. Do not change any error message text, any other validation, or the order of validations.
4. Create tests/test_delivery_token_matcher.py with focused tests that build their own small StoryPackage inputs only if that is easy; otherwise test through the real package at data/stories/continuity-initiative (loaded with `load_story_package`) and a copied package in tmp_path, the way tests/test_gap_rules.py edits a copy of the package with a helper (read that file for the pattern). Required tests: (a) a seeded defect: put a real fact id into a delivery text of a copied package and assert loading raises StoryPackageError whose message contains "implementation-only token" and that fact id; (b) a clean variant: the unmodified package loads; (c) near misses: the matcher does not match a known token when it is glued to a word character or hyphen (for example `x` + token or token + `-y`) but does match it inside normal sentence punctuation (for example `See token.`); test this by calling `_delivery_token_matcher` on the loaded real package with a real fact id and checking `matcher.search(text.casefold())`. Do not use time-based assertions.
5. Run tests/test_delivery_token_matcher.py tests/test_markdown_story_package.py tests/test_story_package_cache.py tests/test_loader_pacing_producers.py tests/test_required_storylet_closure.py, then `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check storygame tests` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check storygame tests`. Fix what you broke.
Leave all changes uncommitted.
